title: Fast high-resolution dither
description: On the user's phone a 640x480 Floyd-Steinberg frame with tape took ~100 ms. VHS only carries ~320 samples per line, so with dither on the tape now runs at tape resolution and is smoothly scaled up before dithering; monochrome error diffusion quantises through a lookup table.

clauses.text: With dither on at high resolution, the tape effect runs at tape resolution: it adds well under the cost of the dither itself instead of more than doubling the frame time.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "tape under hi res dither stays cheap" passes

clauses.text: Black-and-white error diffusion is at least as fast as colour error diffusion of the same picture, with unchanged output.
clauses.observable_by: a test named "monochrome diffusion is not slower than colour" passes, and DitherTest's published-kernel oracle still passes

cases.description: 640x480 Floyd-Steinberg pipeline with VHS on takes at most 1.6x the same pipeline with VHS off (best of three medians)

Floyd-Steinberg at 640x480: 1-bit takes at most 1.1x the time of a 27-colour natural palette (best of three medians) - declared guard: the 2-3x monochrome slowdown was measured on the phone's Android runtime (ART) and does not occur on the desktop JVM, so this test cannot be observed red here; it must keep holding, and the on-device benchmark (Benchmark.kt) is the real check
